bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to stabilize shoreline in St. Louis County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CEMETERY SHORELINE STABILIZATION. +]

[+$2,300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for a grant to St. Louis County to stabilize shoreline near Scandia Cemetery by constructing a retaining wall and a related access road. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to stabilize shoreline in St. Louis County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CEMETERY SHORELINE STABILIZATION.

$2,300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for a grant to St. Louis County to stabilize shoreline near Scandia Cemetery by constructing a retaining wall and a related access road.
